description: Source code for a paging scheduler in a 5G NR network, implementing paging logic, resource allocation, and scheduling based on 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: paging_scheduler
classes.description: Class responsible for managing paging scheduling, resource allocation, and handling paging requests in a 5G NR network.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Executes scheduling logic for a given slot, handling pending paging requests and resource allocation.

methods.name: handle_pending_paging_requests
methods.description: Processes queued paging requests, adding new ones to the pending list if space allows.

methods.name: find_pdsch_time_resource
methods.description: Finds a suitable PDSCH time resource index for paging based on opportunity and space availability.

methods.name: get_accumulated_paging_msg_size
methods.description: Calculates the total size of paging message payloads for a set of UE paging IDs.

methods.name: allocate_paging
methods.description: Allocates resources for paging on PDCCH and PDSCH, including DCI and grant configuration.

methods.name: fill_paging_grant
methods.description: Fills in the paging grant structure with DCI, UE info, and PDSCH configuration.
